items.note: not separate; inner surface of RA wall FJ2439 and auricles (LA wall FJ2438)
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Ridges from the crista terminalis into the right auricle, and ridges lining the left auricle.

items.note: no vagus nerve in either model
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Cervical and thoracic course of both vagi to the oesophageal hiatus.

items.note: not modeled; hooks under right subclavian artery SRC_Z_RIGHT_SUBCLAVIAN_ARTERY

items.note: not modeled; hooks under aortic arch SRC_Z_AORTIC_ARCH
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Hooks under the aortic arch behind the ligamentum arteriosum, ascends in the tracheo-oesophageal groove.

items.note: no phrenic nerve in either model
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Both phrenic nerves from scalenus anterior over the mediastinum to the diaphragm.

items.note: no sympathetic trunk in either model
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Ganglionated chain over the rib heads T1-T12, both sides.

items.note: not modeled
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Roots from T5-T9 ganglia, down the vertebral bodies to the crus at T12, both sides.

items.note: lung parenchyma absent; only bronchial tree (main bronchi FJ2539/FJ2450 + segmental trees) and pulmonary vessels exist
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Both lungs filling each hemithorax around the bronchial tree, bounded by ribs, diaphragm and mediastinum (approximate shape).

items.note: pericardial sac not modeled; would enclose heart walls FJ2428/FJ2438/FJ2439
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Closed sac ~3 mm around the heart and the roots of the great vessels.

items.note: not modeled; connects pulmonary trunk bifurcation/left pulmonary artery (SRC_Z_BIFURCATION_OF_PULMONARY_TRUNK, SRC_Z_LEFT_PULMONARY_ARTERY) to SRC_Z_AORTIC_ARCH
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Fibrous cord from the pulmonary trunk bifurcation / LPA to the underside of the aortic arch.

items.note: apex is the inferolateral tip of Wall of ventricle FJ2428 (LV)
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Inferolateral tip of the ventricular wall (LV).

items.note: base = posterior surface formed mainly by LA (FJ2438) and part of RA (FJ2439)
items.custom_note: Built for this tool. Posterior surface formed mainly by the LA and the posterior RA.
